title: Do not miss an important message
intro: Turn on notifications. moto will then tell you about new messages and important changes concerning your child.
enableError: Notifications could not be enabled. Please try again.
denied: Notifications are blocked in your browser. Open the browser settings, allow notifications for moto, then try again in Settings.
installTitle: Add moto to your Home Screen
installAndroidIntro: Install moto on your Home Screen. Then open moto like an app and turn on notifications.
installAndroidManual: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app” or “Add to Home Screen”.
